description: Product Manager - Power Forecasting About Dexter Energy Dexter Energy is an Amsterdam-based scale-up building AI-based forecasting solutions that help renewable energy companies become more predictable and profitable, pushing fossil fuels out of the market and accelerating the energy transition. Our products power data-driven trading decisions across day-ahead, intraday and imbalance markets. About the role Power Forecasting is Dexter's long-running business line: a proven product with a high win-rate and strong unit economics. The focus now is to increase its commercial scale and grow our customer base across Europe. We are hiring a dedicated Product Manager who sets the direction, owns the product roadmap, builds the go-to-market and growth path. The job is also to sharpen the proposition, packaging and pricing, drive down cost-to-serve, defend against churn and price pressure, and enable our geographic expansion. What you will own Direction & roadmap . Own the course of the business line and the ROI-based product roadmap: set direction, experiment, weigh options, prioritize and defend the choices, steering on clear milestones (when to scale, pivot, or stop) Drive growth . Improve trial conversion, onboarding speed, upsell and retention; focus on geo expansion and on doubling the customer base in the next two years Go-to-market, positioning & selling . Own the value proposition, product marketing, partnerships and growth path. Position the product to win on more than features, and pitch it convincingly for trials, demos and pilots Product discovery . Run product discovery initiatives including e.g. experimentation, market sizing and deep customer interviews that get to the core needs - and turn those insights into product and commercial decisions Packaging & pricing . Differentiate the offer by customer type & size, protect gross margin against price pressure, and remove pricing as a reason we lose good-fit trials Cost-to-serve & CAC . Reduce the cost of acquiring and serving customers: standardize onboarding (e.g. a custom-integration framework), enable self-serve value discovery, and lower operational effort per customer Why this role is exciting You own the product roadmap for our power forecasting product and take it from proven to scaled, with a direct line to commercial impact You join a lean, high-trust environment where you run the product end to end, with a lot of autonomy You get to work with top-tier meteorology, AI and data-science experts, turning their models into commercially successful internationally scaling products You help to accelerate the energy transition by making renewable energy companies become more predictable and profitable You will report to the CPO and you’ll work closely with the Power and Meteo Tech teams, your PM-peers, the Commercial team and the whole Leadership Team What we’re looking for 5+ years in Product Management in international B2B SaaS. Experienced at scaling a product, commercially driven, growth- and revenue-first Proven experience on: Go-to-market, positioning, pricing/packaging and unit-economics fluency (incl. product P&L, LTV/CAC), and ownership of the product roadmap Strong customer-interviewer: you probe to the core and know the difference between selling and interviewing Experience managing data products, APIs, or forecasting / ML products Industry experience in short-term power markets Nice to haves: Experience with renewable / battery asset trading or weather forecasting services is a plus Product-led growth in high-tech/clean-tech environments What we offer Annual base salary €87,000 - €,107,000 (including 8% holiday allowance) Stock Appreciation Rights (SARs): Share in the company’s growth 30 days of paid leave: Enjoy a balanced life Travel compensation: For both your commute and business travel Learning & Development budget: Invest in your personal and professional growth Flexible work environment: A healthy work-life balance, based on trust and autonomy.Do your best work in a way that suits you The opportunity to help accelerate Europe's energy transition Working at Dexter Headquartered in Amsterdam, we’re a hybrid team that balances remote work with in-person collaboration. Most of us work from the office at least 2-3 days a week to brainstorm, exchange ideas, and drive projects forward together. Ready to make an impact? Join Dexter as a Product Manager and be part of a team driving the transition to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future. Apply now and help shape the future of renewable energy optimization! Dexter Energy is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or background.
title: Product Manager

description: Growth Manager – Karnataka Location: BLR Employment Type: Full-time About Namma Yatri & Bharat taxi Namma Yatri, built and operated by Moving Tech, is the tech and strategy partner for Bharat Taxi. Namma Yatri, the world's largest open mobility platform, runs community-led mobility platforms like Namma Yatri (Bengaluru), Yatri Sathi (Kolkata), Chennai One, Odisha Yatri, and Kerala Savari, and is now powering Bharat Taxi with the same open, people-ﬁrst DNA. These platforms, pioneers of a zero-commission, SaaS model, have completed 130M+ trips with driver earnings of over ₹2,200 Cr. Bharat Taxi aims to be the Amul for Mobility - a people-ﬁrst, cooperative-based taxi initiative backed by the Central Government Ministry of Cooperation that offers safe, affordable, and digniﬁed mobility at scale. It brings drivers together on a common platform so they can earn fairly while serving riders with trust and transparency. Together, Bharat Taxi and Namma Yatri are building a multi-city, multi-modal mobility network that serves Samaaj (society), Sarkar (government), and Bazaar (business), aligned with open digital public infrastructure. About the Role We are looking for a high-ownership Growth Manager to drive growth, supply expansion, operational excellence, and conversion improvements across Karnataka. This role sits at the intersection of Ops, Product, Growth, and Analytics. The ideal candidate should be extremely strong with numbers, operational problem-solving, and cross-functional execution. Key Responsibilities Supply-Led Growth & Marketplace Management ● Drive supply growth and marketplace efficiency across cities ● Own key supply metrics including active drivers, online hours, conversion, cancellations, utilisation, and subscription realisation ● Identify and solve demand-supply gaps through structured interventions Conversion & Funnel Optimisation ● Improve conversion metrics across search → booking → completed rides ● Work closely with Product teams to improve user journeys and reduce friction points ● Coordinate with Marketing teams on top-of-the-funnel growth and conversion efficiency Data & Experimentation ● Build dashboards, track cohorts, identify trends, and derive actionable insights ● Run structured experiments across pricing, supply, and engagement levers Operations & Execution Excellence ● Build scalable operational playbooks and improve execution reliability ● Solve operational bottlenecks with speed and ownership What We’re Looking For ● Strong problem solving and structured thinking ● Comfort with data - dashboards, metrics, decision-making from numbers ● Experience in product, program management, consulting, account management ● Experience working with tech and engineering teams ● Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills ● High ownership, bias to action, and comfort with ambiguity ● Interest in impact, mobility, public good, and driver empowerment ● High on empathy and EQ to balance priorities of multiple stakeholders Bonus Points ● MBA from top tier B school ● Experience in mobility, community-led initiatives, cooperatives, public transport, government programs, or platform businesses ● Experience launching or scaling products in new cities or regions

description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India . Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role. 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc). Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in a technology or business related field. 3 years of experience in a business function or role (e.g., strategic marketing, business operations, consulting). 3 years of experience in a role preparing and delivering technical presentations to senior leadership. 2 years of experience in software development or engineering. 2 years of experience working cross-functionally with engineering, UX/UI, sales finance, and other stakeholders. 1 year of experience in technical leadership. About The Job At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. Google Pay is one the leading UPI apps in India. Our mission is to make payments and commerce simple, fast, and reliable to unlock a brighter financial future for all Indians. We aim to provide affordable access to financial services to every Indian. Specifically, Google Pay aims to empower every Indian with the confidence to participate in the digital economy by making it the simplest, safest, and most trusted financial platform. The overall goal is to reduce friction in transactions and increase the value of money experiences. Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses. Responsibilities Work with partner teams (e.g., engineers, PgMs, UX) during product design and development to implement the requirements to turn PRDs into OKRs for one or more teams. Define product roadmaps by operationalizing strategy. Develop and secure buy-in for a product goal that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts. Validate the market size and opportunity (e.g., user-based, strategic opportunity, business generation). Drive launches, maintenance, and retirement in collaboration with other cross-functional teams and stakeholders. description: Forvis Mazars in Ireland is a leading professional services firm with ambitious growth plans and over 1000 staff based in Dublin, Galway, Cork and Limerick. We are an integral part of Forvis Mazars Group, an internationally integrated partnership with over 40,000 professionals operating in over 100 countries and territories around the world. Our strategic framework drives positive and meaningful impact for our people, the environment and local communities while delivering unmatched client experience to our clients. Why join us Our people are ambassadors and leaders and have a bold entrepreneurial spirit to shape the future of our industry and the communities within which we serve. We empower and develop our teams to become professionals of the highest calibre in technical and client excellence. Our people first approach offers our teams a caring work environment which promotes belonging and inclusivity of all cultures and perspectives. The Position The Business Analyst will play a pivotal role in understanding and analyzing the needs of the Department, bridging the gap between professionals, clients and IT. This position involves gathering, documenting, and analyzing business requirements to identify solutions that improve processes, enhance customer experiences, and drive business performance. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a solid understanding of business operations. Key Responsibilities Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with professionals across various departments to gather, define, and document business requirements through interviews, workshops, and surveys. Analyze and clarify requirements to ensure a clear understanding among all parties involved. Business Analysis: Evaluate existing business processes and workflows to identify areas for improvement, optimization, and automation. Develop process maps and documentation to illustrate current and proposed workflows. Data Analysis and Reporting: Utilize data analysis techniques to interpret trends, patterns, and insights to support decision-making processes. Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and data visualizations to communicate findings to stakeholders. Solution Design and Validation: Work closely with IT and development teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications, ensuring alignment with project goals. Participate in the testing and validation of solutions, ensuring that they meet business needs and expectations. Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a point of contact for stakeholders during project lifecycles, providing updates and gathering feedback. Facilitate meetings and workshops to present findings, discuss solutions, and drive consensus. Change Management Support Assist in change management efforts by providing relevant insights and support during the implementation of new processes and systems. Documentation and Knowledge Management: Maintain comprehensive documentation of business requirements, process maps, and project outcomes. Develop training materials and user guides to support the rollout of new systems and processes. Ideal Candidate Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field; advanced degrees or relevant certifications (e.g., IIBA, PMI-PBA) are a plus. Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in business analysis, requirements gathering, and process improvement within a corporate environment. Proven track record of successfully delivering projects that align with business objectives. Skills and Competencies: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail and an ability to think critically. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information to various audiences. Proficiency in business analysis tools and techniques (e.g., UML, BPMN, use cases). Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, Power BI) and database concepts (e.g., SQL). Experience with project management methodologies (Prince 2, PMBOK, Agile, Waterfall) is an advantage. Strong interpersonal skills, capable of building relationships and managing stakeholder expectations. Personal Attributes: Self-motivated and proactive, with a strong commitment to delivering quality results. Adaptable and flexible, able to thrive in fast-paced and evolving environments. Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and a focus on achieving shared goals. Passionate about continuous improvement and innovation within business processes. Don’t wait. Act. description: In deze rol zorg je dat we minder bouwen op aannames en meer op bewijs. Inzichten verdwijnen niet in een rapport, maar werken direct door in betere productbeslissingen. Je toetst hypotheses, maakt impact meetbaar en helpt teams digitale producten bouwen die echt waarde toevoegen. Word onderdeel van ons team Bij Framna bouwen we digitale producten die ertoe doen, voor marktleiders en organisaties die dat willen worden. We geloven in win by product: ons werk stopt niet bij livegang, maar pas bij aantoonbare impact voor de business van onze partners. Daarom zoeken we mensen die niet alleen meten wat er gebeurt, maar ook valideren of het waarde toevoegt. Als Product Analyst versterk je een groeiende product discipline waarin onderzoek, experimentatie en meetbaarheid de standaard zijn. Je werkt direct samen met onze Senior Product Analyst, die je coacht in hypothese-gedreven werken en als inhoudelijke sparringpartner naast je staat. In multidisciplinaire teams werk je samen met Product Owners, Designers en Developers aan producten voor partners in onder andere luchtvaart, retail, gezondheidszorg en financiële dienstverlening. Wat je gaat doen In deze rol zorg je dat productbeslissingen worden genomen op basis van gevalideerd inzicht, niet op gevoel. Je vertaalt businessvragen naar scherpe onderzoeksvragen, daagt aannames uit met bewijs en zorgt dat nieuwe features meetbaar worden opgeleverd. Je werkt mee over de volle breedte van de productcyclus: Bij projectstart Je helpt onderzoeksvragen en toetsbare hypotheses scherp te krijgen, samen met de Senior Product Analyst. Je sluit aan bij product alignment-sessies en helpt succesdefinities en KPI’s concreet te maken. Je gebruikt prioriteringsmodellen zoals RICE om scopediscussies van mening naar onderbouwing te brengen. Tijdens uitvoering Je begeleidt tracking-implementaties samen met development, bijvoorbeeld in GA4, Firebase en GTM. Je schrijft SQL-queries in BigQuery voor data-extractie, funnelanalyses en cohortanalyses. Je ontwerpt en draait zelfstandig A/B-tests en gebruikersonderzoeken op basis van heldere hypotheses. Je bouwt dashboards in Looker Studio die teams en partners ook echt gebruiken Bij afronding en doorwerking. Je vertaalt onderzoeksuitkomsten naar heldere verhalen en concrete aanbevelingen. Je bewaakt dat features meetbaar worden opgeleverd en dat learnings terugkomen in het team. Je draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze interne aanpak voor product research en experimentatie. Wie jij bent Klaar om deze rol echt eigen te maken? Dan denken we dat je goed bij ons past als je: 2 tot 5 jaar ervaring hebt met product research, digital analytics of een vergelijkbare data-gedreven productrol. Sterk bent in GA4 of Firebase, BigQuery en Looker Studio, of vergelijkbare tooling. Vloeiend bent in SQL en zelfstandig queries schrijft voor extractie, funnelanalyses en cohortanalyses. Zelfstandig A/B-tests kunt opzetten en interpreteren, en statistische basisprincipes zoals significantie, power en sample size begrijpt. Hypothese-gedreven werkt en start vanuit de vraag wat je wilt weten en waarom. Sterk bent in data storytelling en analyses altijd vertaalt naar een duidelijke conclusie en concrete vervolgstap. Stevig genoeg in je schoenen staat om tegenspraak te geven als onderzoek iets anders laat zien dan de heersende aanname. Nieuwsgierig bent naar de business van partners en pragmatisch werkt: liever een goede beslissing op basis van goed bewijs dan een perfecte analyse waar niemand iets mee doet. Mooi meegenomen Ervaring met GTM. Ervaring met server-side tracking. Ervaring met Python, bijvoorbeeld pandas, scipy of statsmodels, voor diepere statistische analyses. Over Framna Framna betekent vooruitbrengen. En dat is precies wat we doen. We werken samen met marktleiders en met organisaties die dat willen worden om digitale producten te creëren die markten definiëren, industrieën vernieuwen en betekenisvolle groei realiseren. Vanuit een sterke productgedreven cultuur bouwen we met honderden collega’s aan de toekomst, verspreid over meerdere studio's in Europa en daarbuiten. Dagelijks vertrouwen miljoenen gebruikers wereldwijd op de producten die wij maken. Van soepele betaalervaringen tot dagelijkse mobiliteit, en van gezondheidsbeheer tot slimmer winkelen. Samen met ambitieuze partners bouwen we digitale producten die markten leiden en grenzen verleggen. Want wanneer producten winnen, winnen bedrijven ook. Wij noemen dat: win by product. Wat je krijgt Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.200 en €4.600, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Pensioenbijdrage van 67%. 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen of te verkopen. Vergoedingen voor woon-werkverkeer en thuiswerken. Een MacBook en telefoon in bruikleen. Dagelijkse lunch op de studio. Persoonlijke coaching door onze Senior Product Analyst. Een helder ontwikkelpad richting Senior niveau. Goed om te weten Voor deze rol zoeken we een collega die vloeiend Nederlands spreekt. Wij bieden geen visa sponsorship aan. Het sollicitatieproces Wil jij meebouwen aan digitale producten waar onderzoek en data echt het verschil maken? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. Binnen zeven werkdagen neemt Léon van ons recruitmentteam contact met je op. Klikt het? Dan starten we met een korte online kennismaking. Zijn we daarna allebei nog steeds enthousiast, dan nodigen we je uit in een van onze studios voor een vakinhoudelijk gesprek met de Senior Product Researcher. Klikt het daarna nog steeds? Dan doen we je een aanbod. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature stellen we niet op prijs.
